description:
UnitySVC runs the official Kavita image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Kavita is a self-hosted reading server: it scans folders of comics, manga and e-books (CBZ, CBR, ZIP, RAR, 7z, folders of images, EPUB and PDF), groups them into series, volumes and chapters, and lets you read them in the browser with reading progress, bookmarks, collections, reading lists and several users with their own access. It also serves an OPDS catalog for e-reader apps.

Kavita has no page for uploading books: it reads them from disk. Your books come from your own UnitySVC home: put them in the `kavita/library` folder of your home with the platform's Files page, and the instance copies them in each time it starts. Kavita's database, covers and settings are kept in `kavita/config`. Because the platform copies whole files, the library has to be small enough to copy at every start and to fit in the instance's 5 GiB temporary disk; files over 1 GiB are not stored, and new books appear only after the instance is stopped and started again. This is a small personal library, not a large collection. Enroll in the base channel, which has no settings, open the address at once and register the first account: it becomes the administrator. You can run one Kavita instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Kavita wiki and issue tracker for software-specific help.
